Creating an issue publishes `issue.created` from `src/server/services/issue-service.ts`. Four source files register a handler for that event with `subscribe("issue.created", ...)`:

- `src/server/services/usage-service.ts` (line 74)
- `src/server/services/activity-service.ts` (line 169), which records it in the activity log
- `src/server/services/search-service.ts` (line 139)
- `src/server/services/webhook-service.ts` (line 110), which queues it for the org's webhooks

I also checked the other `subscribe(...)` calls under `src`, including `event-registry.ts` and `notification-service.ts`. None of them listen for this event. The `subscribe("issue.created", ...)` calls under `tests/` are test code, so I left them out. Files that only declare or label the event name aren't handlers either: `src/types/event.ts`, `src/types/activity.ts`, `src/schemas/activity.ts`, `src/schemas/webhook.ts` and `activity-labels.ts`.

ANSWER: src/server/services/usage-service.ts, src/server/services/activity-service.ts, src/server/services/search-service.ts, src/server/services/webhook-service.ts
